page.overview:
What is Paldean Wooper?

Wooper is a small Pokémon with a large head and beady black eyes with white pupils. It has no arms, stubby feet with no legs, a comparatively long tail, and spiky antennae jutting out from its head, on which are four branches that function as gills. Most of its body is a pale blue, including its tail, feet, and head - its eyes, gills, the patterns on its stomach, and the inside of its mouth are the sole exceptions.

Wooper in the Paldea region has a brown coloration, with two pairs of bone-shaped gills branching from its head, as well as an eight-pronged pattern on its stomach.

Male Wooper have four branches on each antenna, while females have only two.

Similarly to Poliwhirl and Clobbopus, Wooper normally live in the water, though they come out of the water to search for food when evening arrives and the temperature drops. When they come up and walk around on land, they coat their bodies with a slimy, gooey film to keep themselves from drying out- however, the film is also toxic and poisonous, so touching them causes a stinging pain. When they go to sleep, they half-bury themselves in mud at the bottom.
